english.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for being alone or unaccompanied, especially when no companion or instructor is present.

exampleSentences.english: I went solo on the trip.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 daan1 duk6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4

english.note: Use this when the emphasis is on being alone or not accompanied by anything else, rather than merely being one in number.

exampleSentences.english: I want to take a single-person trip this time.
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngo5 soeng2 daan1 duk6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
